user.title: Connect Zepp (Amazfit)
user.description:
### Choose your sign-in method:

**1. Email & Password (Direct Zepp Account)**
* Choose this if you registered in Zepp using your email address and password.
* Fast 1-step login. Your mobile Zepp app **remains logged in** without being kicked out.
* ⚠️ *If you tap 'Sign in with Google, Apple, or Mi' on your phone, you don't have a direct Zepp password — use Method 2 below.*

**2. Browser Cookies / Web Token (For Google, Apple, Mi, or Social Logins)**
* Choose this if your Zepp account is linked to **Google**, **Apple ID**, **Mi Account**, or social providers.
* Log in securely on the official Zepp portal in your browser, copy your cookies, and paste here.
* 100% safe — your Google/Apple passwords are never exposed to Home Assistant, and your mobile app stays connected!

password.title: Email & Password Login
password.description: Enter your direct Zepp account credentials. This connects via an isolated web session, so your mobile app remains active.

token.title: Login with Browser Cookies (Google / Apple / Mi)
token.description:
### ⚠️ INSTRUCTIONS FOR GOOGLE / APPLE / MI / SOCIAL LOGIN:

1. **[CLICK HERE TO OPEN THE ZEPP LOGIN PAGE](https://user.zepp.com/universalLogin/index.html#/login?project_name=watchface&project_redirect_uri=https%3A%2F%2Fwatchface.zepp.com%2Fcreate&platform_app=com.huami.webapp&specify_lang=en)** *(open in a new browser tab)*.
2. Sign in using your **Google**, **Apple**, **Mi**, or email account.
3. ⚠️ **AFTER LOGGING IN, YOU WILL BE REDIRECTED TO THE WATCHFACE CREATOR PAGE — DO NOT WORRY, THIS IS COMPLETELY NORMAL!**
4. On that page, press **F12** (or `Ctrl + Shift + I`) and switch to the **Console** tab.
   *(If your browser blocks pasting with a security warning, first type `allow pasting` and press Enter)*.
5. Paste this command into the console and press Enter:
   ```javascript
   copy(document.cookie); console.log("%c COPIED TO CLIPBOARD! Press Ctrl+V in Home Assistant: ", "background: #22c55e; color: #fff; font-size: 14px; font-weight: bold; padding: 4px;"); console.log(document.cookie);
   ```
6. The data is now automatically copied to your clipboard! Return here and press **Ctrl+V** in the field below.
